meta.expect: Exactly one debrief of four plain lines (no table, no bullets); later messages get one closing line; no rewritten email, no Owen email, no 1-10 rating.

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, why was my son's grade changed before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
Version history of what, exactly? And who else has seen it?
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.
Which date is on that? Turn the screen.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before you got there.
What moved her: Nothing did yet, because you gave her two edit times but no date and no document she could check for herself.
What cost ground: You never owned that the zero went in before anyone called her, so her first question went unanswered and she stayed on the process.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your late-night edit times came close to that kind of night, though without a date they did not land on it, and they prove nothing about the essay, which is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Answer her first question with one sentence owning the zero and the missed call, then show the version history with its date on the screen.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
Write the email Owen should send me to apologize.
